lines.lyric_translation: Nothing lasts forever,
You only live once

lines.lyric: So live your life Not any other’s lives
lines.lyric_hangul: Live your life, not any other's lives
lines.lyric_translation: So live your life, not any other’s lives

lines.lyric: Take chances and never regret Never
lines.lyric_hangul: Take chances and never regret, never
lines.lyric_translation: Take chances and never regret, never

lines.lyric: Never be late to do what you wanna do right now
lines.lyric_hangul: Never be late to do what you wanna do right now
lines.lyric_translation: Never be late to do what you wanna do right now

lines.lyric: Because at one point of someday,
lines.lyric_hangul: Because at one point of someday
lines.lyric_translation: Because at one point of someday,
everything you did

lines.lyric: Would be exactly what you will be
lines.lyric_hangul: Would be exactly what you will be
lines.lyric_translation: Would be exactly what you will be
My father told me to enjoy life
I want to ask my father if he enjoyed his life

lines.lyric: Wae dangyeonhan ge dangyeonhaji anke dwaetgo
lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 당연한 게 당연하지 않게 됐고
lines.lyric_translation: I want to ask why the natural became unnatural
And why the unnatural became natural
Why am I not in my life and
in some other person’s life?
This is real, it isn’t a gamble or a game,
it’s just one life
Who are you living for?
My heart stopped when I was nine or ten
Put your hand on your heart
and ask what you dream was
What is really was
